messages:
omar: Heads-up: I'm building a "effective config preview" feature for Console so engineers can see exactly what runtime values a cohort will get before pushing a rollout. Thinking it should show resolved keys + a small traffic simulation. Thoughts?
trina: Love it. Key constraints: 1) only visible to roles in the approval chain, 2) preview must produce an immutable snapshot_id to tie to audits.
ben: How heavy will resolution be? We have customers with thousands of cohorts and multi-layer overrides. If every preview runs full resolution it could be expensive.
carmen: We can do deterministic sampling. API takes sample_size & seed, returns that sample's resolved results plus aggregated stats (percent of sample hitting each variant). Cheap + reproducible.
omar: Proposed API shape: GET /v1/configs/{id}/preview?cohort=foo&sample=250&seed=7&simulate=10000
Response should include: snapshot_id, sample_count, resolved_map, diff_against_active, simulation_summary.
audit-bot: audit: config_preview_requested config_id=cfg_9d2 user=omar cohort=foo sample=250 seed=7 snapshot= - pending
trina: Telemetry notes: emit a `config.preview` event with (config_id, user_id, cohort, sample, seed, snapshot_id, simulate). But scrub cohort membership fields in telemetry and limit rates.
ben: Implementation ideas: 1) snapshot the set of base/defaults (etag) at preview start, 2) run resolution against that snapshot, 3) persist minimal blob pointing to snapshot + sample seed. Snapshot GC policy: keep snapshots for 30 days by default.
carmen: UI: show a compact delta panel with green/red highlights, and a "simulate traffic" slider (e.g., 1k, 5k, 10k requests) that shows projected quota consumption, estimated cost delta, and a simple latency percentile shift assuming our route model.
omar: Edge cases: - secrets or KMS ARNs in config values must be redacted in previews - previews must be RBAC-guarded and logged - previews shouldn't trigger downstream routing changes (read-only)
ben: Agree. Also propose a `dry_run_apply` API flag for targeted limited rollout tests that actually exercises routing in a safe sandbox for a subset of traffic; separate from preview which is read-only.
trina: For privacy-sensitive tenants, add an org-level flag to disable previews entirely. Also add an opt-in to include telemetry for their previews.
audit-bot: audit: snapshot_created config_id=cfg_9d2 snapshot_id=snap_2025-03-14_17-42 stored_by=preview-service
omar: I'll draft an RFC with API spec, telemetry schema, snapshot retention defaults, privacy checklist. Link will go in this thread when ready.
deploy-bot: preview-service v1 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
carmen: Acceptance criteria I'd like in the RFC: reproducible sample+seed, snapshot_id in response, RBAC enforcement, redaction of secrets, UI delta, telemetry event with sampling policy, GC policy documented.
ben: I'll take the worker + snapshot persistence piece. Will restrict sample size to 500 in the first pass, and return an approximate aggregated distribution when sample==max.
trina: Please add a small experiment in Console that records whether preview influenced the approval decision (checkbox) so we can measure utility. Keep that telemetry decoupled from PII and cohort membership.
omar: Great idea. OK next steps: I'll open the RFC and a small mock UI. Will assign infra tasks for worker + rate-limiter.
audit-bot: issue created: ENG-4472 "preview + snapshot infra" assigned -> ben
omar: Thanks all. Will ping when RFC link is up.
